title: The 10 Best Cordless Grease Guns
subtitle: Battery-powered grease guns for tractors, trucks, mowers and equipment, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless grease gun pumps grease with a motor instead of your hand, which saves hours on farm, fleet and equipment maintenance. We ranked 10 best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (a battery in the box, a hose of 40 inches or more, speed control and a work light).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Grease Gun Kit with 4.0Ah Battery and Charger, LED Light, 42" Hose (DCGG571M1)
products.best_for: Farms and shops without DEWALT batteries that want a proven grease gun.
products.verdict: The same DEWALT grease gun with a 4.0Ah battery and charger in the box, for anyone starting from scratch.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Grease Gun, 42" Hose, 10,000 PSI, Variable Speed Trigger, Tool Only (DCGG571B)
products.best_for: DEWALT owners greasing tractors, mowers, trailers and equipment.
products.verdict: The best-selling cordless grease gun here: 10,000 PSI to push through clogged fittings, 5 oz per minute, a variable speed trigger and a 42-inch hose, for DEWALT 20V MAX owners.
cons: 5 oz/min, slower than RYOBI and CRAFTSMAN's claims

products.name: Milwaukee 2646-22CT M18 2-Speed Grease Gun Kit with 2 Compact Batteries
products.best_for: Starting on Milwaukee M18 with a grease gun.
products.verdict: The Milwaukee 2646 as a kit with two compact M18 batteries. The listing itself is thin, with filler bullets, but it's the same 2-speed gun as the bare 2646-20.

products.name: TaskStar Cordless Electric Grease Gun Kit with 2 Batteries, Lock-On Trigger, 40" Hose & LED Light
products.best_for: Occasional greasers without a battery platform who want everything in one box.
products.verdict: A complete kit with two 2.0Ah batteries, a charger, a case and a shoulder strap. It matches DEWALT's 10,000 PSI and 5 oz per minute, adds a lock-on trigger, and weighs 5.6 lb.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Grease Gun, 40" Hose, LED Light, 10,000 Max PSI, up to 9 oz/min, Tool Only
products.best_for: CRAFTSMAN V20 owners who want a fast-flowing grease gun.
products.verdict: A CRAFTSMAN V20 grease gun with a two-speed transmission, variable speed trigger, LED and a 40-inch hose. It claims up to 9 oz per minute, the highest flow listed here.

products.name: Seesii 2-in-1 Cordless Electric Grease Gun, 12000 PSI, with 2 Batteries and 48" Hose
products.best_for: Farm and equipment owners who want a full kit on a budget.
products.verdict: A budget kit with two 2.0Ah batteries, a 48-inch hose, an LED and a 12,000 PSI rating. The listing claims enough runtime to grease up to 8 tractors per charge.

products.name: Milwaukee 2646-20 M18 2-Speed Grease Gun, Bare Tool
products.best_for: Milwaukee M18 owners and anyone who greases equipment daily.
products.verdict: Milwaukee's M18 grease gun with two speeds, a 48-inch hose, an air bleeder valve for quick priming and a lock-on trigger. Milwaukee lists a 5-year tool warranty.
cons: One of the priciest bare tools here

products.name: Alloyman 2-in-1 Cordless Grease Gun Kit, 12000 PSI, 2 x 4.0Ah Batteries
products.best_for: Long greasing sessions with no tool batteries to share.
products.verdict: A kit with two larger 4.0Ah batteries and a handle that switches between pistol and straight grips. The listing claims up to 12 tractors per charge.

products.name: RYOBI 18V ONE+ Cordless Grease Gun P3410 (Tool Only)
products.best_for: RYOBI owners greasing mowers, ATVs and trailers.
products.verdict: RYOBI's ONE+ grease gun claims a fast 7.5 oz per minute at 10,000 PSI, with a steel grease tube and an LED light. The 30-inch hose is the shortest here.

products.name: Ecarke Cordless Grease Gun Compatible with DeWalt 20V Battery, 12,000 PSI, 39 in Hose and 4 Couplers (Tool Only)
products.best_for: DEWALT battery owners who want a powered grease gun for well under the DCGG571B's price.
products.verdict: A bare tool that runs on DEWALT 20V MAX batteries, with a handle that turns between pistol and straight grips and a listed 8 oz/min flow. It loads cartridges or bulk grease and comes in a hard case with four couplers.
pros: Hard case, 4 couplers and a shoulder strap
cons: A third-party tool on DEWALT batteries isn't covered by DEWALT

specs.included: Tool only; hard case, 4 couplers, shoulder strap

avoid.name: SXBSXB 2-in-1 Cordless Grease Gun for DeWalt 20V Battery, 12,000 PSI, 39.4 in Hose (No Battery)
avoid.flag: Sold as a 'kit' with no battery, for more than complete kits
avoid.verdict: A bare tool priced above kits that include batteries. The title calls it a 'Grease Gun Kit' and then says '(No Battery)'.
reasons: At $129.99 with no battery or charger, it costs $20 more than the Alloyman HYQ-03 on this page, which has a near-identical model number and comes with two 4.0Ah batteries and a charger.
The title says 'Electric Grease Gun Kit', but the first bullet says it is sold as a bare tool only.
It lists a 6 oz/min flow; the Ecarke bare tool for the same DEWALT batteries lists 8 oz/min and costs $97.72.

buyers_guide.q: How much pressure do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Most grease fittings take far less than 10,000 PSI. The high rating matters for clogged or seized fittings, where a manual gun can't push through. Every gun here except the M12 is rated 10,000 PSI or more.
Flow (oz per minute) is how fast grease comes out. Higher flow fills big bearings and equipment faster. DEWALT lists 5 oz/min; RYOBI and CRAFTSMAN claim 7.5 to 9 oz/min.

If you own batteries from the same brand, buy the bare tool. If you don't, a kit from DEWALT or Milwaukee costs more but leaves you on a platform you can grow into. The no-name kits are cheapest but their batteries fit nothing else.
All of these take standard 14 oz cartridges. Many can also be filled from a bulk tub, which is cheaper if you grease a lot of equipment.

buyers_guide.q: How long a hose do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Forty inches or more lets you reach fittings under a mower deck or up on a loader arm without moving the gun. The RYOBI's 30-inch hose is the shortest here.
